hook.text: A diamond has five named parts.

lines.text: A diamond has five named parts.
The table is the flat facet on top.
The crown is the upper part, from the table to the girdle.
The girdle is the narrow band around the middle.
The pavilion is the lower part, from the girdle to the point.
Last, a tiny facet called the culet may cap the point.
A standard round brilliant has 58 facets, or 57 with no culet.
lines.say: A standard round brilliant has fifty eight facets, or fifty seven with no culet.

lines.text: A girdle too thin hurts durability, and one too thick hides weight.

scene.sub: Not too thin, not too thick

lines.text: So the five parts run in order, table first, culet last.
A render shows the table and crown before anything is cast.

post.caption: A cut diamond has five named parts: the table on top, the crown above the girdle, the narrow girdle around the middle, the pavilion below it and the tiny culet at the point. A standard round brilliant has 58 facets, or 57 when there is no culet. A girdle that is too thin hurts durability, and one that is too thick hides weight.
